WorkloadIdentityConfig.description: The workload identity configuration of the pod identity association. When enabled, the association also provisions a SPIFFE identity for the workload. Setting Enabled to false disables workload identity and keeps the ARNs. Removing the property from the template leaves the association unchanged; set Enabled to false to disable workload identity.

Enabled.description: Whether workload identity is enabled for the association. Enabling it requires TemplateArn and ProviderArn, and cannot be combined with TargetRoleArn.
Enabled.markdownDescription:
Whether workload identity is enabled for the association. Enabling it requires TemplateArn and ProviderArn, and cannot be combined with TargetRoleArn.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: Boolean  
Update requires: No interruption

TemplateArn.description: The ARN of the customer-owned IAM workload identity template that renders the workload's SPIFFE identity.
TemplateArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the customer-owned IAM workload identity template that renders the workload's SPIFFE identity.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Pattern: ^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:workload-identity-template/[^/]+$  
Update requires: No interruption

ProviderArn.description: The ARN of the customer-owned IAM workload identity provider that produces the trusted context assertion for the workload.
ProviderArn.markdownDescription:
The ARN of the customer-owned IAM workload identity provider that produces the trusted context assertion for the workload.

Update requires: No interruption
